overview.description: The Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF (CHPS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive Semiconductor Focus index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of the 50 largest companies involved in the semiconductor industry globally. CHPS was launched on Jul 13, 2023 and is issued by Xtrackers.

data.title: Red-Hot Chip Stocks Are Lifting Tech ETFs. One ETF Has Doubled Since It Launched Last Month.
data.text: Some exchange-traded funds offer the safety of diversification at the expense of eye-popping returns. This year, returns are the story, especially at funds that hold big slugs of red-hot chip shares.
